title: Fleet Define Specification
description: Simplified JSON Schema for defining SDTM or ADaM dataset metadata in Fleet. Enforces structure, types, and codelist references. Generates Define-XML 2.1 and powers post-dataset checks.

codelists.description: Shared codelists referenced by variables in this define.

datasets.description: Dataset definitions — one entry per SDTM domain or ADaM dataset.

fleet_spec_version.description: Optional spec-format version. from_spec() and DefineSpecGenerator reject versions this Fleet build does not understand.

derivations_module.description: Dotted Python module imported by from_spec() before execution so that its @derivation / register_transform callables are available (removes the import-order footgun for `algorithm: callable`).

ct.title: CTConfig
ct.description: Controlled-terminology configuration for spec-driven execution. With validate: true, from_spec() runs assign-family derivations that declare a codelist with validate_values=True (out-of-codelist values warn, naming dataset/variable/codelist).

validate.description: Opt the spec into CT pass-through validation.

file.description: Optional CT file (.yaml/.csv) loaded into the validator cache before execution; relative paths resolve against the spec file.

output_format.description: Default export format for all datasets — drives def:leaf hrefs in Define-XML and output paths in the pipeline DAG. Overridable per dataset.

domain.description: Simplified single-dataset format: SDTM domain this spec derives (e.g. 'DM'). Mutually exclusive with datasets:.

dataset.description: Simplified single-dataset format: ADaM dataset this spec derives (e.g. 'ADSL'). Mutually exclusive with datasets:.

variables.description: Simplified single-dataset format: derivations with inline algorithm fields and a target:/name: key, executed by from_spec(). Algorithm names and their parameters are validated by the spec registry rather than this schema.

study.title: Study
study.description: Study-level metadata shared across all datasets in this define.

originator.description: Organization or team creating this define.

standard.description: CDISC implementation guide this define conforms to.

standard_version.description: Version of the implementation guide (e.g. '3.4' for SDTMIG).

ct_version.description: SDTM (or SEND) Controlled Terminology version used (e.g. '2023-12-15').

adam_ct_version.description: ADaM Controlled Terminology version, for an ADaM define with ADaM-only codelists such as DTYPE (e.g. '2023-06-30'). The Define-XML then lists both CT standards.

documents.description: Supporting documents referenced from Define-XML (annotated CRF, reviewer guide, etc.).

codelist.title: Codelist
codelist.description: A controlled terminology codelist referenced by variables. Every term with a decode gives CodeListItem, no term with a decode gives EnumeratedItem (a mix is an error); external: gives ExternalCodeList.

type.description: Data type of the coded values.

standard_oid.description: def:StandardOID: the declared CT standard of this codelist (STD.CT when study.ct_version is set, STD.CT.ADAM when study.adam_ct_version is set). Default: STD.CT for a codelist whose oid is an NCI code (C66731) when study.ct_version is set.

decode.description: Human-readable meaning of the coded value. Give it on every term (CodeListItem) or on none (EnumeratedItem).

nci_code.description: NCI code of the term (e.g. C16576), written as Alias Context nci:ExtCodeID.

extended.description: True for a sponsor term that extends an extensible CDISC codelist: def:ExtendedValue Yes.

nci_code.description: NCI code of the codelist (e.g. C66731), written as Alias Context nci:ExtCodeID.

external.description: An external dictionary (e.g. MedDRA) in place of terms: written as ExternalCodeList.

dataset.title: Dataset
dataset.description: Definition of a single SDTM domain or ADaM dataset.

name.description: SAS dataset name / domain (e.g. DM, ADSL).

label.description: Dataset label (max 40 chars for SAS compatibility).

structure.description: Observation structure description (e.g. 'One record per subject').

repeating.description: Define-XML Repeating: whether the dataset has more than one record per subject. Default: No for DM, ADSL and the trial design datasets (TA, TE, TV, TI, TS, TD, TM), Yes for every other dataset.

is_reference_data.description: Define-XML IsReferenceData: whether the dataset holds reference data, not subject data. Default: Yes for TA, TE, TV, TI, TS, TD, TM and for class TRIAL DESIGN, No for every other dataset.

class.description: CDISC dataset class (e.g. SPECIAL PURPOSE, FINDINGS, EVENTS).

keys.description: Ordered list of key variable names that uniquely identify a record.

inputs.description: Upstream datasets or raw source files this dataset depends on. Used to build the pipeline DAG.

output.description: Explicit output path for this dataset (used verbatim as the Define-XML def:leaf href; resolved against the DAG output_dir when relative). When omitted, the path is {name.lower()}{ext} per output_format.

output_format.description: Export format override for this dataset (see the top-level output_format).

value_level.description: Value-level metadata entries (Define-XML ValueListDef/WhereClauseDef) — parameter-dependent derivations of BDS datasets.

row_steps.description: Steps that remove or add records, in pipeline order (ADR-0034). Each step runs after the variable named in after: (null: before the first variable). from_spec refuses algorithm: TODO. Rendered in Define-XML as the dataset comment.

subset.description: nodup: the key of a duplicate.

verb.description: TODO: the inline verb that the spec does not describe yet.

dataset_input.title: DatasetInput
dataset_input.description: An upstream dependency of a dataset — either a raw source file or another pipeline dataset.

name.description: Logical node name. For raw files use a short identifier (e.g. 'dm_raw'); for datasets use the dataset name (e.g. 'DM', 'ADSL').

type.description: 'raw' for source files (csv, sas7bdat, xpt, parquet, etc.); 'dataset' for upstream pipeline datasets.

path.description: File path for raw inputs relative to the study root (the folder of study_config.yaml). Omit for dataset-type inputs (path is resolved from the DAG).

variable.title: Variable
variable.description: A single variable (column) in a dataset.

name.description: Variable name (uppercase, max 8 chars for SAS compatibility).

type.description: ODM data type. 'text' maps to Polars String; 'integer' to Int64; 'float' to Float64; 'date' to Date; 'datetime' to Datetime.

length.description: Define-XML Length. Text: the maximum number of characters. Integer and float: the number of digits, whole digits plus decimals (not the SAS storage length of 8). Required on text, integer and float; not allowed on date and datetime.

significant_digits.description: Define-XML SignificantDigits: the number of decimals. Required on float; not allowed on other types.

mandatory.description: Whether the variable is required in every record.

core.description: CDISC core designation for the variable. When present, the checker uses this for graduated severity (Req → error, Exp → warning, Perm → info). Users may override the IG value to downgrade Req variables.

origin.description: How the value originates — the Define-XML 2.1 Origin Type vocabulary, shared with QORIG in generated SUPPQUAL datasets. Use 'Collected' (with origin_source) for CRF/eDT data; Define-XML 2.0 spellings such as 'CRF' and 'eDT' are not valid here.

origin_source.description: Who provided a collected value — emitted as def:Source alongside Origin. Only meaningful when origin is 'Collected', where it defaults to 'Investigator' (CRF data).

predecessor.description: DATASET.VARIABLE the value is carried from (e.g. 'DM.COUNTRY') — becomes the Origin description so the define renders 'Predecessor: DM.COUNTRY'. Required when origin is 'Predecessor'.

codelist.description: OID of the codelist this variable references (must match a codelist oid in this define).

role.description: Marks the variable as a Non-Standard Variable (qualifier). fleet run moves it to SUPP<domain> with SDTMNamespace.export_supp(spec=...); 'qualifier' is the only value Fleet acts on.

sdtm_role.description: The SDTM role of the variable, written as the ItemRef Role of the Define-XML (CORE rule CG0010 reads it). fleet init define fills it from the CDISC Library; check a sponsor-specific role by hand.

evaluator.description: Evaluator for a Non-Standard Variable — becomes QEVAL in the generated SUPPQUAL dataset (e.g. 'INVESTIGATOR').

comment.description: Free-text comment or derivation note for this variable.

oneOf.description: Space-separated physical page numbers in the annotated CRF (e.g. '7' or '8 9').
Rich CRF page reference with explicit document, page type, and range.

crf_pages.description: CRF page reference(s) for collected variables. Simple string form uses PhysicalRef against the default annotated CRF. Dict form allows NamedDestination and multi-document references.

derivation.description: Derivation rule that drives the pipeline when from_spec() is called. Omit for columns that are not programmatically derived (e.g. carry-through columns).

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Supporting document references for the Define-XML submission package.

annotated_crf.description: Annotated Case Report Form PDF referenced from collected variables.

href.description: Relative path to the annotated CRF PDF file (e.g. 'blankcrf.pdf').

page_map.description: Path to an external YAML file mapping DOMAIN.VARIABLE keys to CRF page references. Merged with inline crf_pages; inline values take precedence.

supplemental_docs.description: Additional supporting documents (reviewer guide, protocol, etc.).

id.description: Unique leaf ID for this document (e.g. 'LF.ReviewerGuide').

href.description: Relative path to the document file.

crf_page_ref.title: CRFPageRef
crf_page_ref.description: Rich CRF page reference supporting multiple documents and page reference types.

doc.description: Document href to reference. Defaults to the annotated_crf href.

pages.description: Space-separated page numbers or named destinations.

first_page.description: First page of a page range.

last_page.description: Last page of a page range.

value_level_entry.title: ValueLevelEntry
value_level_entry.description: One value-level slice: a condition (param: sugar for PARAMCD equality, or an explicit where:) plus the variable definitions/derivations that apply within it.

param.description: Shorthand: this entry applies where PARAMCD equals the given value.

variables.description: Variable definitions (with derivations) valid within this slice.

where_clause.title: WhereClause
where_clause.description: Condition selecting the records a value-level entry applies to (Define-XML def:WhereClauseDef / RangeCheck).

value.description: Value (EQ) or list of values (IN) the variable must match.

derivation.title: Derivation
derivation.description: Describes how a variable is derived by the Fleet pipeline engine. The algorithm is the verb; the keys are its keyword arguments. Validated per verb: unknown keys are rejected. Generated from fleet.core.spec_registry — do not edit by hand; run `python -m fleet.define_xml.schema_builder` to regenerate.

anyOf.description: Shorthand callable block — `algorithm: derivation` is injected automatically when only `callable:` is present.
